name: Heidi Health
description: Heidi Health is an Australian-founded AI scribe that has grown to 10,000+ clinicians globally. In February 2026, Heidi rebranded with a significant price increase: the Clinician plan (formerly Pro) now costs $150/month billed annually—up from ~$99. Key limitation: EHR write-back requires the Practice tier ($99/mo with EHR integrations), so the $150 Clinician plan still requires manual copy-paste. Heidi includes a generous free tier (10 Pro Actions/month) and 14-day trial. Best for primary care, family medicine, and Australian practices with native Best Practice/Medical Director integrations. Not built for mental health—therapists should use Mentalyc or Upheal instead.

seo.title: Heidi Health: $150/mo AI Scribe 2026 | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Heidi Health AI scribe: Feb 2026 rebrand increased Clinician to $150/mo (from $99). Free tier available. Australian native EHRs. Not for mental health.

faqs.q: How much does Heidi Health cost in 2026?
faqs.a: After Feb 2026 rebrand: Free (10 Pro Actions/month), Evidence Plus ($40/mo), Clinician ($150/mo billed annually—up from ~$99), Practice ($99/mo with EHR integration), Enterprise (custom). Critical: the Clinician plan does NOT include EHR write-back—that requires Practice tier.

faqs.q: Why did Heidi Health pricing increase?
faqs.a: In February 2026, Heidi restructured its plans and raised the main tier (now called Clinician, formerly Pro) from ~$99/month to $150/month. The Practice tier at $99/mo includes EHR integrations that Clinician lacks.

faqs.q: Is Heidi Health good for therapists?
faqs.a: No. Heidi was designed for primary care and general practice, not mental health. Therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) which understand therapy modalities. Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo).

faqs.q: Does Heidi Health integrate with Epic?
faqs.a: Heidi uses a browser extension for Epic (not native API). EHR write-back requires the Practice tier ($99/mo)—the Clinician tier ($150/mo) is copy-paste only. US practices wanting deep Epic integration should consider Abridge or Nuance DAX instead.

faqs.q: Is Heidi Health worth it for US practices?
faqs.a: It depends. Heidi's native EHR integrations are strongest in Australia (Best Practice, Medical Director). US practices on Epic/Cerner get browser extension only. At $150/mo without EHR write-back, Freed ($39-119/mo) or Sunoh ($149/mo with EHR integration) may offer better value.
